title: Leçon 1 — greet someone and take my leave, choosing the right formality and time of day

meta.can_do: I can greet someone and take my leave, choosing the right formality and time of day.

visuals: GOAL CARD — "Greet and take your leave" · can-do text

beats.text: This is lesson one, so there is nothing to bring back yet. Just get ready to speak out loud.
Listen to two people meet and part. Understand what you can — you are not expected to catch every word.
One question: did they meet in the morning or the evening? Answer out loud, in English.
Both — they greet with bonjour, then part with bonsoir as evening comes.

beats.text: Morning or evening where you are right now? Greet a woman with the right word, and thank her. Say it out loud, then write it down.
visuals: SCENE — a scene at your own front door · WORD BANK: hello / good evening / ma’am / thank you · MIC

beats.text: Here is one way to say it. If yours differs but the pieces fit, it’s right.
You’re leaving a shop. Say goodbye to the man behind the counter, and that you’ll see him soon. Say it out loud, then write it down.
visuals: SCENE — leaving a small shop · WORD BANK: goodbye / sir / see you soon · MIC

beats.text: Here is one way to say it. If yours differs but the pieces fit, it’s right.
It’s evening. Greet a woman, then politely ask — with please. Say it out loud, then write it down.

beats.text: You can now greet and take your leave, morning or evening, formally or casually. That’s the whole can-do.
These twelve come back in your app in two days — say them, don’t just read them.
